messages:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from today's all-hands q&a. pulling together the process questions so leadership can answer in one thread. please keep replies concise.

Jordan Lee: two items that popped up during the live q&a: 1) are we aligning on one release cadence org-wide? 2) what are the hard perf gates for runtime changes?

Priya Nair: short version: product teams default to biweekly releases; teams can opt into weekly canaries for rapid feedback. infra/runtime teams should use weekly cycles for low-risk fixes, and staged rollouts (canary -> partial -> full) for higher-risk infra.

Priya Nair: perf gating: required bench artifacts for any PR touching serving paths. block if p95 latency regression >10% or memory increases >15% on the same load profile. include baseline and branch benchmarks in PR description.

Marcus Flynn: oncall follow-up: primary rotation remains 1 week, secondary 2 weeks. we're trialing a single handoff post in #eng-oncall every Monday 09:00 PT that includes runbook links and recent alerts.

Jordan Lee: SLA question from a customer-facing PM: what latency numbers do we advertise for Dedicated customers and do we have automated fallbacks?

Maya Patel: Dedicated plans have contractual p95 latency targets; guidance we'll publish: small-seq p95 <= 200ms, long-context p95 <= 500-600ms depending on model. automated fallback chains (model variant -> region -> degraded-variant) are enabled by default for critical routes. we'll add a concise FAQ line for customers.

Priya Nair: can infra/eng-sre publish the exact metric IDs teams should use for automated checks? we need metric names for PR templates.

Marcus Flynn: yes 1: will post metric ids (latency_p95, latency_p99, qps, memory_rss) and a tiny bench script to #eng-sre by tomorrow EOD.

DeployBot: canary lane created by @Priya Nair for release/1901 680 24h window.

Maya Patel: i'll host a 30-min office hours tomorrow 11:30am PT to walk through examples (when to pick weekly canary vs biweekly release), review the PR checklist, and confirm oncall handoff wording. agenda will be posted.

Jordan Lee: will bring a sample bench run and a draft PR template snippet.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone 44d. i'll post meeting notes + action items after office hours.
